Commentary: Blessing Muzarabani to Louren Steenkamp, no run, pushes this length ball towards cover-point
Newman Nyamhuri, left-arm fast medium, comes into the attack
Newman Nyamhuri to Jan Frylinck, 1 run, hard length, Jan Frylinck pushes from the crease and outside-edges towards short third man

Newman Nyamhuri to Louren Steenkamp, 1 run, that would have been a screamer had he caught! Fullish outside off, driven off the front foot and Wellington Masakadza dives to his right but fails to hold onto it. Great effort though. The extra cover fielder has a shy at the stumps, misses and that allows the batters to take the single
Newman Nyamhuri to Jan Frylinck, FOUR, short ball, sits up nicely and Jan Frylinck slams the pull well in front of square on the leg-side. Speeds away to the fence
Newman Nyamhuri to Jan Frylinck, no run, better lift on this occasion and Newman Nyamhuri bangs it in short. Jan Frylinck is late on the pull and the ball bounces over his right shoulder

Newman Nyamhuri to Jan Frylinck, 1 run, dropped! Jan Frylinck goes after this short ball with a pull shot, not a full-blooded shot and almost pays the price. Ben Curran runs in from deep midwicket and dives forward but the ball doesn't stick
Newman Nyamhuri to Louren Steenkamp, no run, seams away from a length outside off, Steenkamp drives and gets beaten on the outside edge

Blessing Muzarabani to Jan Frylinck, 1 run, short of length outside off, Frylinck stands tall to slap and toe-ends it towards mid-off. A risky single taken and fortunately for Frylinck, there's no direct-hit at the bowler's end
Blessing Muzarabani to Louren Steenkamp, FOUR, that's hit with a lot of authority. Back of a length ball, Steenkamp stands tall and slams it over mid-on for a one-bounce four. Stand and deliver
Blessing Muzarabani to Louren Steenkamp, no run, shortish ball angling in, Steenkamp backs away and hops before defending it
Blessing Muzarabani to Louren Steenkamp, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Blessing Muzarabani to Louren Steenkamp, out Caught by Wesley Madhavere!! Blessing Muzarabani gets his man. A slower ball on a full length and the batter doesn't pick it. He stays leg-side and plays a half-hearted shot. He was probably looking to go over the covers. Checks his shot and the ball lobs up in the air. Wesley Madhavere moves to his left in the short third man area to take the catch. Louren Steenkamp c Wesley Madhavere b Blessing Muzarabani 6(7) [4s-1]
Gerhard Erasmus, right handed bat, comes to the crease
Blessing Muzarabani to Gerhard Erasmus, 1 run, in-slanting short of length delivery, Erasmus gets off the mark by turning it to square leg
Blessing Muzarabani to Jan Frylinck, no run, away-slanter with good bounce on a short of length, Frylinck pokes and gets beaten on the outside edge

Newman Nyamhuri to Gerhard Erasmus, FOUR, too much width outside off and that's been punished. The length is on the shorter side as well and Erasmus waits on the back foot to cut it to deep backward point

Newman Nyamhuri to Gerhard Erasmus, FOUR, back-to-back fours! Nyamhuri serves width again. Erasmus waltzes down the pitch, makes room in the process and slaps it over the covers. The ball bullets away to the fence
Newman Nyamhuri to Gerhard Erasmus, no run, fuller ball on the stumps, driven to point off the front foot

Newman Nyamhuri to Gerhard Erasmus, 1 run, big shout for lbw, turned down. Erasmus gets down to play the sweep shot and misses to get hit on the front pad. It was on a fullish length and the angle would have taken it past the off-stump. Given as a run
Newman Nyamhuri to Jan Frylinck, 1 run, driven to the right of cover
Newman Nyamhuri to Gerhard Erasmus, 1 run, chopped to mid-off
Brad Evans, right-arm fast medium, comes into the attack

Brad Evans to Gerhard Erasmus, 1 run, short of length close to off, Erasmus shapes to heave across the line and gets an under edge that goes to the keeper on the bounce. Tadiwanashe Marumani can't stop it cleanly and the batters steal a single
Brad Evans to Jan Frylinck, no run
Brad Evans to Jan Frylinck, 1 run, short of length, pulled through midwicket
Brad Evans to Gerhard Erasmus, THATS OUT!! Caught!!
Brad Evans to Gerhard Erasmus, out Caught by Brian Bennett!! Gerhard Erasmus c Brian Bennett b Brad Evans 12(8) [4s-2]
Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton, left handed bat, comes to the crease
Brad Evans to Loftie-Eaton, 1 run, back of a length, Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton
Brad Evans to Jan Frylinck, FOUR, shortish delivery, leg-lined and Frylinck swivels to help it on its way to fine leg with a pull shot
Newman Nyamhuri to Loftie-Eaton, 1 run, to mid-on
